title: Wuthering Heights
descr: Wuthering Heights is Emily Brontë's only novel, written between October 1845 and June 1846, and published in 1847 under the pseudonym 'Ellis Bell'.

title: Jane Eyre
descr: Jane Eyre is a novel by English writer Charlotte Brontë, published under the pen name 'Currer Bell', on 16 October 1847.

title: The Raven
descr: The Raven is a narrative poem by American writer Edgar Allan Poe. First published in January 1845, the poem is often noted for its musicality, stylized language, and supernatural atmosphere.

title: Eleonora
descr: Eleonora is a short story by Edgar Allan Poe, first published in 1842 in Philadelphia in the literary annual The Gift.

title: Catweazle
descr: Catweazle is a British fantasy television series created and written by Richard Carpenter for ITV.
